meta.name: agentic-engineering
meta.description: Operate as an agentic engineer using eval-first execution, decomposition, and cost-aware model routing. Use when AI agents perform most implementation work and humans enforce quality and risk controls.

copy.tagline: 用评估驱动和成本感知路由来编排AI代理开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果主要靠AI代理写代码，但你需要把控质量和成本。
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate AI agent development with eval-first execution and cost-aware routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you rely on AI agents for most coding but need to enforce quality and cost controls.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照“先定义评估标准、再分解任务、最后执行”的流程工作，并自动根据任务复杂度选择不同级别的模型（如 Haiku、Sonnet、Opus），同时记录每次任务的成本和结果。
howto.when: 当你需要管理 AI 驱动的开发流程、分解任务、选择模型、或审查 AI 生成的代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我分解用户登录功能为15分钟的子任务。
say.note: Claude 会按分解原则输出多个独立可验证的子任务。

say.text: 用评估优先的方式实现这个功能，先写测试。
say.note: Claude 会先定义评估标准，再执行实现。

say.text: 这个任务该用哪个模型？Haiku、Sonnet 还是 Opus？
say.note: Claude 会根据任务复杂度推荐合适的模型层级。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow an eval-first, decomposition, and cost-aware model routing workflow, automatically selecting model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) based on task complexity and tracking costs and outcomes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to manage AI-driven development workflows, decompose tasks, select model tiers, or review AI-generated code.

say_en.text: Decompose the user login feature into 15-minute units.
say_en.note: Claude will output independent verifiable subtasks.

say_en.text: Implement this feature eval-first, write tests first.
say_en.note: Claude will define eval criteria before implementation.

say_en.text: Which model tier should I use for this task?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend based on complexity.
